result.rationale: The diff explicitly shows `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token";` in parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts. In GoogleCalendarService, the returned data (googleCredentials) is persisted via `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key } })`, so a fabricated sentinel refresh_token would be saved as real credential state and later submitted to the provider during fallback refresh. This is a verifiable defect introduced by the diff.

judged_text: packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts:25 — [P1, confidence 100] The sentinel branch `if (!refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token) { refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"; }` serializes a fabricated credential as live state, so adapters later treat it as present and submit it during provider fallback; central refresh ownership does not save this because team credentials and configuration changes still enter fallback.
